extension.summary: Resolver SDK for Rave Player — direct, Mediafire, Drive, Podomatic and Mega.
Resolver SDK for Rave Player — direct, Mediafire, Drive, Podomatic and Mega.
extension.description: Shared Python resolver module for Rave Player. Resolves provider page links to directly playable audio URLs entirely on the Kodi device for direct files, Mediafire and Google Drive, with an optional NAS /api/resolve service fallback for Mega, Podomatic and future sources. No credentials are logged; private and loopback addresses are refused before any request.
